mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 5.0%), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO below 100), the manufacturing sector slowdown signals reduced corporate capital expenditure, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 1.0% signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 1.0%), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a contraction in both manufacturing and construction sectors, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both INDPRO and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly employment growth above 150,000 jobs (PAYEMS > 150000) signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 150000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong retail sales (RSAFS above 450,000 million dollars), consumer spending growth supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 450000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
